verses.sloka: ततो वित्रासयन्मर्त्यान्पृथिव्यां राक्षसाधिपः ।आससाद घने तस्मिन्नारदं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ।। ७.२०.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato vitrāsayanmartyānpṛthivyāṁ rākṣasādhipaḥ ।āsasāda ghane tasminnāradaṁ munipuṅgavam ।। 7.20.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, the lord of demons, terrifying mortals on earth, met Narada, the foremost among sages, in that dense region.
translations.hindi: —— नोना ८ € एकोनशबिः सग : अथ जिला मरुत्त स प्रययौ राक्षसाधिपः । नगराणि नरेन्द्राणां युद्ठाकांती दशाननः

verses.sloka: तस्याभिवादनं कृत्वा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः ।अब्रवीत्कुशलं पृष्ट्वा हेतुमागमनस्य च ।। ७.२०.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyābhivādanaṁ kṛtvā daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ ।abravītkuśalaṁ pṛṣṭvā hetumāgamanasya ca ।। 7.20.2 ॥

translations.english: Having offered his salutations, Dashagriva, the night-wanderer, spoke after inquiring about his well-being and the reason for his arrival.

verses.sloka: नारदस्तु महातेजा देवर्षिरमितप्रभः ।अब्रवीन्मेघपृष्ठस्थो रावणं पुष्पके स्थितम् ।। ७.२०.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāradastu mahātejā devarṣiramitaprabhaḥ ।abravīnmeghapṛṣṭhastho rāvaṇaṁ puṣpake sthitam ।। 7.20.3 ॥

translations.english: The divine sage Narada, of immense splendor and effulgence, spoke to Ravana, who was seated in the Pushpaka chariot, while Narada himself was positioned on a cloud-top.
translations.hindi: अथवा मुझसे आपना हार साना! क्याक सन यहा ।नम्चय कर रखा है कि, जो राजा इन दो बातों में से एक भी स्वीकार न करेगा उसका किसी प्रकार से छुटकारा न हो सकगा

verses.sloka: राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य तिष्ठ विश्रवसः सुत ।प्रीतो ऽस्म्यभिजनोपेतविक्रमैरूर्जितैस्तव ।। ७.२०.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasādhipate saumya tiṣṭha viśravasaḥ suta ।prīto 'smyabhijanopetavikramairūrjitaistava ।। 7.20.4 ॥

translations.english: "O gentle lord of Rakshasas, son of Vishravas, stop," Narada said, "I am pleased by your mighty valor, which is befitting your noble lineage."

verses.sloka: विष्णुना दैत्यघातैश्च गन्धर्वोरगधर्षणैः ।त्वया समं विमर्दैश्च भृशं हि परितोषितः ।। ७.२०.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: viṣṇunā daityaghātaiśca gandharvoragadharṣaṇaiḥ ।tvayā samaṁ vimardaiśca bhṛśaṁ hi paritoṣitaḥ ।। 7.20.5 ॥

translations.english: I am indeed greatly pleased by your battles, which are comparable to Vishnu's slaying of demons and your subjugation of Gandharvas and Uragas.
translations.hindi: हम सब तुमसे अपनी हार सादते हैं । ( थह उन्होंने इस लिए कहा था कि ) वे जानते थे कि, रावण को बरदान का बल है | अतः राज्ञा दुष्यन्त, सुरथ, गाधि, गय और पुरूरवा आदि सब राजाओं ने कह दिआ कि, हम तुमसे पराजित हुए । तदनन्तर रावण अयोध्यापुरी सें पहुँचा

verses.sloka: किंचिद्वक्ष्यामि तावत्ते श्रोतव्यं श्रोष्यसे यदि ।श्रुत्वा चानन्तरं कार्यं त्वया राक्षससत्तम ।तन्मे निगदतस्तात समाधिं श्रवणे कुरु ।। ७.२०.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁcidvakṣyāmi tāvatte śrotavyaṁ śroṣyase yadi ।śrutvā cānantaraṁ kāryaṁ tvayā rākṣasasattama ।tanme nigadatastāta samādhiṁ śravaṇe kuru ।। 7.20.6 ॥

translations.english: I will first tell you something that should be heard, if you are willing to listen, and after hearing it, you, O best of Rakshasas, must act upon it; therefore, O dear one, pay close attention to my words.
translations.hindi: ॥ अयाऽणाधिपतिस्तस्य श्रत्वा पापात्मनो वचः छः है IN! श्‌ को 09५ आवरण्यस्तु संक्रद्ों राक्सेन्द्रमशात्रवीत्‌ ॥ & किन्त अयोध्याधिपति महाराज अनरण्य ने उस पापी के यह वचन सुन और कध हो राक्षसराज रावण से कहा

verses.sloka: किमयं वध्यते तात त्वया ऽवध्येन दैवतैः ।हत एव ह्ययं लोको यदा मृत्युवशं गतः ।। ७.२०.७ ।।्तम ।देवदानवदैत्यानां यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् ।अवध्येन त्वया लोकः क्लेष्टुं युक्तो न मानुषः ।। ७.२०.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kimayaṁ vadhyate tāta tvayā 'vadhyena daivataiḥ ।hata eva hyayaṁ loko yadā mṛtyuvaśaṁ gataḥ ।। 7.20.7 ।।्tama ।devadānavadaityānāṁ yakṣagandharvarakṣasām ।avadhyena tvayā lokaḥ kleṣṭuṁ yukto na mānuṣaḥ ।। 7.20.8 ॥

translations.english: O dear one, why do you kill this world, which is already destined to die and cannot be killed by the gods, when it is already under the sway of death?

verses.sloka: नित्यं श्रेयसि सम्मूढं महद्भिर्व्यसनैर्वृतम् ।हन्यात्कस्तादृशं लोकं जराव्याधिशतैर्युतम् ।। ७.२०.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: nityaṁ śreyasi sammūḍhaṁ mahadbhirvyasanairvṛtam ।hanyātkastādṛśaṁ lokaṁ jarāvyādhiśatairyutam ।। 7.20.9 ॥

translations.english: It is not proper for you, who are invincible to gods, danavas, daityas, yakshas, gandharvas, and rakshasas, to torment the human world.

verses.sloka: तैस्तैरनिष्टोपगमैरजस्रं यत्र कुत्र कः ।मतिमान्मानुषे लोके युद्धेन प्रणयी भवेत् ।। ७.२०.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: taistairaniṣṭopagamairajasraṁ yatra kutra kaḥ ।matimānmānuṣe loke yuddhena praṇayī bhavet ।। 7.20.10 ॥

translations.english: Who would kill such people who are constantly bewildered about their welfare, surrounded by great misfortunes, and afflicted by hundreds of old age and diseases?

verses.sloka: क्षीयमाणं दैवहतं श्रुत्पिपासाजरादिभिः ।विषादशोकसम्मूढं लोकं त्वं क्षपयस्व मा ।। ७.२०.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣīyamāṇaṁ daivahataṁ śrutpipāsājarādibhiḥ ।viṣādaśokasammūḍhaṁ lokaṁ tvaṁ kṣapayasva mā ।। 7.20.11 ॥

translations.english: Who among the intelligent would be fond of war in the human world, which is constantly afflicted by various undesirable occurrences everywhere?
translations.hindi: हे राक्षसराज ! ठहर जा । मैं तुमसे हन्द्रयुद्ध करता हुँ । तू भी सावधान हो चा और में भी लड़ने के लिए तयार होता हूँ

verses.sloka: पश्य तावन्महाबाहो राक्षसेश्वर मानुषम् ।मूढमेवं विचित्रार्थं यस्य न ज्ञायते गतिः ।। ७.२०.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: paśya tāvanmahābāho rākṣaseśvara mānuṣam ।mūḍhamevaṁ vicitrārthaṁ yasya na jñāyate gatiḥ ।। 7.20.12 ॥

translations.english: Do not you destroy the human world, which is already wasting away, struck by fate, afflicted by hunger, thirst, old age, and other miseries, and bewildered by dejection and sorrow.
translations.hindi: महाराज अनरण्य ने पहिले ही रावण का वृत्तान्त सुन कर, अपनी सेना सजा रक्खी थी, सो उनकी वह सेना राक्षस को वध करने को निकली

verses.sloka: क्वचिद्वादित्रनृत्यादि सेव्यते मुदितैर्जनैः ।रुद्यते चापरैरार्तैर्धाराश्रुनयनाननैः ।। ७.२०.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kvacidvāditranṛtyādi sevyate muditairjanaiḥ ।rudyate cāparairārtairdhārāśrunayanānanaiḥ ।। 7.20.13 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed lord of Rakshasas, just behold the human being, who is so foolish and whose strange nature or destiny is not truly known.
translations.hindi: हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ ! उस सेना में दस हजार हाथी, एक लाख घोड़े तथा सहस्रो घुड़सवार तथा पैदल सेनिक थे;

verses.sloka: मातापितृसुतस्नेहैर्भार्याबन्धुमनोरमैः ।मोहितो ऽयं जनो ध्वस्तः क्लेशं स्वं नावबुध्यते ।। ७.२०.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: mātāpitṛsutasnehairbhāryābandhumanoramaiḥ ।mohito 'yaṁ jano dhvastaḥ kleśaṁ svaṁ nāvabudhyate ।। 7.20.14 ॥

translations.english: At times, joyful people engage in music and dance, while at other times, distressed individuals weep with faces and eyes streaming with tears.

verses.sloka: अलमेनं परिक्लिश्य लोकं मोहनिराकृतम् ।जित एव त्वया सौम्य मर्त्यलोको न संशयः ।। ७.२०.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: alamenaṁ parikliśya lokaṁ mohanirākṛtam ।jita eva tvayā saumya martyaloko na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.20.15 ॥

translations.english: Deluded by affection for parents, children, charming wives, and relatives, this afflicted person does not comprehend his own suffering.

verses.sloka: अवश्यमेभिः सर्वैश्च गन्तव्यं यमसादनम् ।तन्निगृह्णीष्व पौलस्त्य यमं परपुरञ्जय ।। ७.२०.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: avaśyamebhiḥ sarvaiśca gantavyaṁ yamasādanam ।tannigṛhṇīṣva paulastya yamaṁ parapurañjaya ।। 7.20.16 ॥

translations.english: Enough of tormenting this world, which is already overcome by delusion; O gentle one, the mortal world has indeed been conquered by you, there is no doubt about it.
translations.hindi: कुछ देर तक उत्तम विक्रम प्रकाश कर वैसे ही नष्ट हो गई जैसे अग्नि में डाली हुई होम की सामग्री भस्म हो जाती है

verses.sloka: तस्मिञ्जिते जितं सर्वं भवत्येव न संशयः ।एवमुक्तस्तु लङ्केशो दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा ।अब्रवीन्नारदं तत्र सम्प्रहस्याभिवाद्य च ।। ७.२०.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmiñjite jitaṁ sarvaṁ bhavatyeva na saṁśayaḥ ।evamuktastu laṅkeśo dīpyamānaṁ svatejasā ।abravīnnāradaṁ tatra samprahasyābhivādya ca ।। 7.20.17 ॥

translations.english: All these beings must inevitably go to the abode of Yama, therefore, O son of Pulastya, O conqueror of enemy cities, subdue Yama himself.

verses.sloka: महर्षे देवगन्धर्वविहार समरप्रिय ।अहं समुद्यतो गन्तुं विजयार्थं रसातलम् ।। ७.२०.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: maharṣe devagandharvavihāra samarapriya ।ahaṁ samudyato gantuṁ vijayārthaṁ rasātalam ।। 7.20.18 ॥

translations.english: When Yama is conquered, everything is indeed conquered, there is no doubt; thus addressed, the lord of Lanka, shining with his own splendor, then spoke to Narada, having laughed heartily and saluted him.
translations.hindi: महाराज अनरण्य ने देखा कि, जैसे सैकड़ों नदियाँ समुद्र गिर कर बिला जाती हैं; बेसे ही उनकी सेना रावण द्वारा ला दी गई अर्थात्‌ नष्ट कर दी गई

verses.sloka: ततो लोकत्रयं जित्वा स्थाप्य नागान्सुरान्वशे ।समुद्रममृतार्थं च मथिष्यामि रसालयम् ।। ७.२०.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato lokatrayaṁ jitvā sthāpya nāgānsurānvaśe ।samudramamṛtārthaṁ ca mathiṣyāmi rasālayam ।। 7.20.19 ॥

translations.english: Ravana addresses the sage, declaring his readiness to descend to Rasatala for conquest.

verses.sloka: अथाब्रवीदृशग्रीवं नारदो भगवानृषिः ।क्व खल्विदानीं मार्गेण त्वया ह्यन्येन गम्यते ।। ७.२०.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: athābravīdṛśagrīvaṁ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।kva khalvidānīṁ mārgeṇa tvayā hyanyena gamyate ।। 7.20.20 ॥

translations.english: Ravana further states that after conquering the three worlds and subjugating the Nagas and gods, he will churn the ocean for nectar.

verses.sloka: अयं खलु सुदुर्गम्यः प्रेतराजपुरं प्रति ।मार्गो गच्छति दुर्धर्षो यमस्यामित्रकर्शन ।। ७.२०.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ khalu sudurgamyaḥ pretarājapuraṁ prati ।mārgo gacchati durdharṣo yamasyāmitrakarśana ।। 7.20.21 ॥

translations.english: Then, the divine sage Narada asked Ravana, "By which path are you indeed going now?"

verses.sloka: स तु शारदमेघाभं हासं मुक्त्वा दशाननः ।उवाच कृतमित्येव वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.२०.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu śāradameghābhaṁ hāsaṁ muktvā daśānanaḥ ।uvāca kṛtamityeva vacanaṁ cedamabravīt ।। 7.20.22 ॥

translations.english: Narada warns Ravana that this path, O tormentor of enemies, is indeed very difficult to traverse and leads to the formidable city of Yama, the king of the dead.
translations.hindi: तस्य याणाः पतन्तस्ते चक्रिरे न क्षति कचित्‌ । वारिधारा इदाभ्रे भ्यः पतन्त्यो गिरिमू्धनि ॥ २१,॥ जल की धारा जैसे बादल से निकल कर पवत के शिखर पर गिरती है और पहाड़ की कुछ सी हानि नहीं कर सकती; बैसे ही वे वाण रावण के मस्तक पर गिरे । किन्तु उनसे रावण के शरीर में कहां खरोच भी न हुईं

verses.sloka: तस्मादेवमहं ब्रह्मन् वैवस्वतवधोद्यतः ।गच्छामि दक्षिणामाशां यत्र सूर्यात्मजो नृपः ।। ७.२०.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādevamahaṁ brahman vaivasvatavadhodyataḥ ।gacchāmi dakṣiṇāmāśāṁ yatra sūryātmajo nṛpaḥ ।। 7.20.23 ॥

translations.english: Dashanana, however, let out a laugh resembling an autumn cloud and then spoke these words, saying, "It is done."

verses.sloka: मया हि भगवन्क्रोधात्प्रतिज्ञातं रणार्थिना ।अवजेष्यामि चतुरो लोकपालानिति प्रभो ।। ७.२०.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: mayā hi bhagavankrodhātpratijñātaṁ raṇārthinā ।avajeṣyāmi caturo lokapālāniti prabho ।। 7.20.24 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O Brahmana, being thus intent on slaying Vaivasvata (Yama), I proceed to the southern direction where the son of Surya, the king (Yama), resides.

verses.sloka: तदिह प्रस्थितो ऽहं वै प्रेतराजपुरं प्रति ।प्राणिसङ्क्लेशकर्तारं योजयिष्यामि मृत्युना ।। ७.२०.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadiha prasthito 'haṁ vai pretarājapuraṁ prati ।prāṇisaṅkleśakartāraṁ yojayiṣyāmi mṛtyunā ।। 7.20.25 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, O revered one, I, desirous of battle, have vowed in my anger, "I shall conquer the four guardians of the world, O lord."
translations.hindi: तब रावण ने इद्वाङुकुलनन्दन अनरण्य से हँस कर कहा-तूने मुझसे लड़ कर क्या फल पाया १

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा दशग्रीवो मुनिं तमभिवाद्य च ।प्रययौ दक्षिणामाशां प्रविष्टः सह मन्त्रिभिः ।। ७.२०.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā daśagrīvo muniṁ tamabhivādya ca ।prayayau dakṣiṇāmāśāṁ praviṣṭaḥ saha mantribhiḥ ।। 7.20.26 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, I have now indeed set out towards the city of the king of the dead, and I shall unite with death the one who causes distress to living beings.

verses.sloka: नारदस्तु महातेजा मुहूर्तं ध्यानमास्थितः ।चिन्तयामास विप्रेन्द्रो विधूम इव पावकः ।। ७.२०.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāradastu mahātejā muhūrtaṁ dhyānamāsthitaḥ ।cintayāmāsa viprendro vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ ।। 7.20.27 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken and saluted that sage, Dashagriva (Ravana) departed towards the southern direction, accompanied by his ministers.
translations.hindi: रावण द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जाने पर हीनवल महाराज अनरण्य ते रावण से कहा कि, ( सुझे जीतने की ) तुम्हारी तो क्या सामर्थ्य है ! हाँ काल ळी बलिहारी हे जिसके प्रभाब से कोई बच नहीं सकता

verses.sloka: येन लोकास्त्रयः सेन्द्राः क्लिश्यन्ते सचराचराः ।क्षीणे चायुषि धर्मेण स कालो जेष्यते कथम् ।। ७.२०.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: yena lokāstrayaḥ sendrāḥ kliśyante sacarācarāḥ ।kṣīṇe cāyuṣi dharmeṇa sa kālo jeṣyate katham ।। 7.20.28 ॥

translations.english: But the greatly effulgent Narada, the chief among Brahmanas, having assumed meditation for a moment, pondered like a smokeless fire.
translations.hindi: हे राक्षस ! अपने मुख से अपनी प्रशंसा करने बाले तूने मुझे नहीं जीता; किन्तु काल मे ही सुझे इस प्रकार विपदूग्रस्त किआ है । हाँ आप इसमें निमित्त मात्र अवश्य हैं

verses.sloka: स्वदत्तकृतसाक्षी यो द्वितीय इव पावकः ।लब्धसञ्ज्ञा विजेष्यन्ते लोका यस्य महात्मनः ।। ७.२०.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: svadattakṛtasākṣī yo dvitīya iva pāvakaḥ ।labdhasañjñā vijeṣyante lokā yasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 7.20.29 ॥

translations.english: How can that Time, by whom the three worlds including Indra and all animate and inanimate beings are tormented, and by whose law life itself is exhausted, ever be conquered?
translations.hindi: इस समय तो सं मर ही रहा हू, सो अब भ॑ कर ही क्या सकता हूँ । ( किन्तु स्मरण रख ) में युद्ध से विमुख नहीं हुआ, प्रत्युत युद्ध करता हुआ में तेरे हाथ से सारा गया हू

verses.sloka: यस्य नित्यं त्रयो लोका विद्रवन्ति भयार्दिताः ।तं कथं राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽसौ स्वयमेव गमिष्यति ।। ७.२०.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: yasya nityaṁ trayo lokā vidravanti bhayārditāḥ ।taṁ kathaṁ rākṣasendro 'sau svayameva gamiṣyati ।। 7.20.30 ॥

translations.english: How can one conquer that great being (Yama), who is a witness to all deeds, like a second fire, and by whom all conscious beings in the worlds are eventually overcome?
translations.hindi: इतने में क्रोध में भर रावण ने महाराज के सिर पर एक थप्पड़ जमाया । उसकी चोट से महाराज अनरण्य विद्वत्त हो थरथराते हुए रथ से धरती पर ऐसे गिरे; जैसे बन में विजली का मारा साखू का पेड़ गिरता हे

verses.sloka: यो विधाता च धाता च सुकृतं दुष्कृतं तथा ।त्रैलोक्यं विजितं येन तं कथं विजयिष्यते ।। ७.२०.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: yo vidhātā ca dhātā ca sukṛtaṁ duṣkṛtaṁ tathā ।trailokyaṁ vijitaṁ yena taṁ kathaṁ vijayiṣyate ।। 7.20.31 ॥

translations.english: How can this king of Rakshasas (Ravana) personally go to conquer him, from whom the three worlds always flee, tormented by fear?
translations.hindi: महाराज इच्वाक के कुल में दाशरथी राम उत्पन्न होंगे जो तेरा वध करेंगे

verses.sloka: अपरं किन्तु कृत्वायं विधानं संविधास्यति ।कौतूहलसमुत्पन्नो यास्यामि यमसादनम् ।। ७.२०.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: aparaṁ kintu kṛtvāyaṁ vidhānaṁ saṁvidhāsyati ।kautūhalasamutpanno yāsyāmi yamasādanam ।। 7.20.32 ॥

translations.english: How will he conquer him who is the ordainer and sustainer of both good and bad deeds, and by whom the three worlds are already subdued?

verses.sloka: विमर्दं द्रष्टुमनयोर्यमराक्षसयोः स्वयम् ।। ७.२०.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vimardaṁ draṣṭumanayoryamarākṣasayoḥ svayam ।। 7.20.33 ।।

translations.english: What other plan will this Ravana make after this, but filled with curiosity, I myself will go to the abode of Yama.
